p: He is teaching us the following … domains join
He is teaching us the following two things. First, that domains join
an object in airspace is considered at rest.
four cubits in the covered public domain is exempt because it is not similar to the flags of … the desert,
four cubits in the covered public domain is exempt because it is not similar to the flags of the camp of Israel in the desert,
Weren’t the wagons on which they transported the beams of the Tabernacle covered?
Rav said in the name of Rabbi Ḥiyya:

w.23: to the flags of … the desert

p: how much was the length of … wagon?
how much was the length of a wagon?
How much was the width of … beam? … a cubit and a half. … How many … place
How much was the width of a beam? It was a cubit and a half. How many beams could one place
When the Master distributes half a cubit between
would place the beams on their width? … They would place them on their depth,
would place the beams on their width? They would place them on their depth,
g: כאשר יזרוק, יחלק את החלל הזה בין לבין

p: how much was the depth of a beam? … one cubit. … How many … would … place? … four … One cubit … remained.
how much was the depth of a beam? It was one cubit. How many stacks would they place? They would place four stacks. One cubit of open space remained.
When the Master distributes … between … it is considered lavud, … This
When the Master distributes one cubit between the four stacks of beams it is considered lavud, as two handbreadths separated each stack. The Gemara adds: This
well according to … the one who said
well according to the opinion of the one who said
were one cubit thick at the bottom,
they narrowed to a fingerbreadth as they reached the top.
just as they were one cubit thick at the bottom,
were one cubit thick on top,
